title: Remediation Tracking and Single-Finding Retest Foundation
goal: Add a first-class remediation loop without redefining the existing finding schema by introducing additive remediation tracking, linked retest runs, and proof-of-resolution output.
scope: Implement the first remediation slice by adding an additive remediation tracking model tied to findings, a single-finding retest launch path linked back to the original finding, and a proof-of-resolution report variant that reuses the existing evidence, reporting, and provenance structures.
generation_reason: Anti-drift hardening for the repo-backed post-intake backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not promote or implement this task until the current task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed and logged.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep this slice to additive remediation tracking, one finding-scoped retest path, and proof-of-resolution output. Defer batch retest orchestration, ticketing integrations, and broader workflow automation.
notes: Do not expand the existing FindingUpdate.status literal in this slice.
Use an additive remediation record or equivalent additive metadata layer instead of redefining finding schema fields.

success_criteria: Operators can record remediation state and notes for a finding without changing the existing finding status contract.
A single-finding retest run can be launched and linked back to its source finding and source run.
Proof-of-resolution output shows the original finding, remediation notes, retest evidence, and verification timestamp in one report path.
Findings Theater and report surfaces expose the remediation and retest linkage truthfully.
API, report, and browser tests cover the additive remediation path.

acceptance_criteria: A finding can move through remediation tracking without breaking existing finding.status API compatibility.
A retest launched from a finding remains linked to the original evidence and run context.
The proof-of-resolution report is exportable and honest when remediation or retest data is missing.

before_promotion: The active conversational-intake task in NEXT_TASK.md is completed, logged, and removed from active status.
python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py passes with this package still queued.
No remediation status expansion is attempted through api/app/schemas/findings.py in the same promotion.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with the remediation slice, linked retest evidence, and validation results.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the additive remediation and proof-of-resolution behavior.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md and rerun python3 scripts/validate_backlog_tasks.py.

out_of_scope: Jira, ServiceNow, Slack, or Teams integration
Changes to the existing FindingUpdate.status enum
